# C4: Plugins, workspace files, executors and the local API

C4 is every interface between Atticus and code outside it: plugins that read files (extractors and ingestors), adapters to external systems, the workspace and change files, the step executor protocol, and the local API the UI uses.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version           | Value |
| ----------------- | ----- |
| Workspace files   | 1     |
| Change state file | 1     |
| Executor protocol | 1     |
| Local API         | 1.0.0 |

## Plugins

Extractors read a repository and emit catalog records; ingestors read one input file (a diagram, a document, an export). Both read files only: no network, no AI model, no clock (timestamps come from the scan context), so a scan is deterministic and a plugin's output can be cached by commit. Everything a plugin emits is validated against C1; invalid records are reported and never written.

```ts
interface RepoHandle {
  readonly name: string; // repo name from the repo manifest
  readonly commit: string; // commit being scanned
  listFiles(globs: readonly string[]): AsyncIterable<string>;
  readText(path: string): Promise<string>;
}

interface ScanContext {
  readonly dialects: readonly string[];
  readonly component?: string; // the component this repo builds
  readonly system?: string;
  readonly repoType?: string;
  readonly scannedAt: string; // ISO timestamp of this scan
  warn(message: string, path?: string): void;
}

interface Extractor {
  readonly id: string; // lowercase slug
  readonly version: string; // semver; part of the cache key and of every record's evidence
  readonly claims: readonly string[]; // file globs it reads
  scan(repo: RepoHandle, ctx: ScanContext): AsyncIterable<CatalogRecord>;
}

interface Ingestor {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly version: string;
  sniff(fileName: string, head: Uint8Array): number; // 0..1
  ingest(fileName: string, content: Uint8Array, ctx: ScanContext): AsyncIterable<CatalogRecord>;
}
```

## Adapters

Adapters connect Atticus to external systems by type: work tracker, service desk, Git host, wiki, design tool, notifications, each with a manual fallback. Every write to a shared system goes through an adapter call that carries an explicit approval from a person; this is not configurable.

## Local API

The local API (version 1.0.0) is an OpenAPI 3.1 document, generated from the same schemas and committed at [docs/api/openapi.json](../../api/openapi.json). It listens on 127.0.0.1 only and every request carries the per-session token printed at start-up.

## RepoManifest

Where: `org-pack/profiles/<profile>/repos.manifest.yaml`.

| Field                   | Type                | Required | Values          | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `schemaVersion`         | 1                   | yes      |                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `platform`              | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                 | Stable record id. Lowercase slug, safe as a file name on Linux, macOS and Windows (no ":" or "/"), so every record can live in its own file named by its id. |
| `repos`                 | object[]            | yes      |                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `repos[].id`            | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                 | Repo id; also the base clone's folder name under workspace/.                                                                                                 |
| `repos[].url`           | string              | yes      |                 | Clone URL. Credentials never go here; Git's credential manager supplies them.                                                                                |
| `repos[].defaultBranch` | string              | no       | default `main`  |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `repos[].type`          | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                 | Repo type from the platform profile, e.g. spring-boot, gateway, infra. Maps to build commands.                                                               |
| `repos[].owner`         | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                 | Owning team id (roles.yaml).                                                                                                                                 |
| `repos[].component`     | string (RecordId)   | no       |                 | The component this repo builds, when its id differs from the repo id (ADR 0016).                                                                             |
| `repos[].system`        | string (RecordId)   | no       |                 | The catalog System this repo belongs to, when one repo maps to one system.                                                                                   |
| `repos[].extractors`    | string (RecordId)[] | no       |                 | Extractor ids to run on this repo; empty means the profile's defaults for the type.                                                                          |
| `repos[].dialects`      | string (RecordId)[] | no       |                 | Dialect ids to run on this repo.                                                                                                                             |
| `repos[].sparse`        | string[]            | no       |                 | Partial clone: only these paths are checked out. Empty means the whole repo.                                                                                 |
| `repos[].build`         | string              | no       |                 | Build or test command overriding the profile's command for this repo type.                                                                                   |
| `repos[].archived`      | boolean             | no       | default `false` | Archived repos stay listed for history but are not cloned or scanned.                                                                                        |

## RunResult

Executor → Atticus, once: what happened.

| Field             | Type                            | Required | Values                                      | Description                                                                |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`            | "result"                        | yes      |                                             |                                                                            |
| `runId`           | string                          | yes      |                                             |                                                                            |
| `status`          | enum (RunStatus)                | yes      | `done`, `failed`, `needs-person`            |                                                                            |
| `outputs`         | map of any                      | no       |                                             |                                                                            |
| `evidence`        | object[]                        | no       |                                             |                                                                            |
| `evidence[].kind` | enum                            | yes      | `screenshot`, `page`, `log`, `file`, `link` |                                                                            |
| `evidence[].ref`  | string                          | yes      |                                             | A file path, page URL or log reference: never the content of a credential. |
| `evidence[].at`   | string (datetime) (IsoDateTime) | no       |                                             |                                                                            |
| `message`         | string                          | no       |                                             |                                                                            |
| `startedAt`       | string (datetime) (IsoDateTime) | no       |                                             |                                                                            |
| `finishedAt`      | string (datetime) (IsoDateTime) | no       |                                             |                                                                            |

## PingResponse

| Field        | Type     | Required | Values          | Description |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- | --------------- | ----------- |
| `type`       | "pong"   | yes      |                 |             |
| `name`       | string   | yes      |                 |             |
| `version`    | string   | yes      |                 |             |
| `procedures` | string[] | no       |                 |             |
| `stepKinds`  | string[] | no       |                 |             |
| `fillOnly`   | boolean  | no       | default `false` |             |

## IdempotencyCheck

Atticus → executor: was this idempotency key used? Only a "no" allows a retry without new approval.

| Field            | Type    | Required | Values | Description |
| ---------------- | ------- | -------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `type`           | "check" | yes      |        |             |
| `idempotencyKey` | string  | yes      |        |             |

## IdempotencyAnswer

| Field            | Type      | Required | Values | Description |
| ---------------- | --------- | -------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `type`           | "checked" | yes      |        |             |
| `idempotencyKey` | string    | yes      |        |             |
| `used`           | boolean   | yes      |        |             |
